items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I danced, I did my act and I did a number with Judy Garland called -- what's the name of that song? 'Me and My Shadow,' is it? Yeah, 'Me and My Shadow' I think we did.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. And I want to get away from --I forgot to tell you about being with -- I told you about Judy Garland in the Met in the rounds --
Well, we haven't really gotten into that in specific terms. Can you tell me about that?
